All tasks complete. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

## Harness Generation Summary: crossbeam-skiplist

### Output Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `harness/src/tla_trace.rs` | Per-thread timebox trace module (rdtsc intervals, thread-local writers) |
| `harness/src/trace_tests.rs` | 3 test scenarios: basic_ops, concurrent_insert_remove, interleaved_ops |
| `harness/src/preprocess_trace.py` | Merges per-thread NDJSON files, compresses timestamps to dense ints |
| `harness/patches/instrumentation.patch` | Patches Cargo.toml, lib.rs, base.rs, map.rs (365 lines) |
| `harness/apply.sh` | Applies instrumentation to clean artifact |
| `harness/run.sh` | End-to-end: apply, build, test, preprocess, verify |
| `harness/INSTRUMENTATION.md` | Guide for Phase 3 agent to adjust instrumentation |

### Traces Generated

| Trace | Events | Threads | Overlap |
|-------|--------|---------|---------|
| `basic_ops.json` | 14 | 1 | 0 (sequential baseline) |
| `concurrent_insert_remove.json` | 20 | 2 | 1 pair |
| `interleaved_ops.json` | 57 | 2 | 2-6 pairs |

### Event Type Coverage: 7/8 instrumented

All event types appear in traces: InsertBegin, InsertCAS, InsertBuildLevel, RemoveBegin, RemoveMarkTower, RemoveUnlink, ReleaseEntry. Get events are emitted only when found (not-found case skipped since spec's Get is a no-op).

### TLC Validation

The `basic_ops` trace successfully matched through all 14 events (15 states). The only failure is the `TraceMatched` temporal property due to missing fairness constraint — a known pattern for Category B traces. The Phase 3 agent should use deadlock-based completion checking or add fairness.

### Spec Fixes Applied

- `Trace.cfg`: `Thread = {"t1", "t2"}` (strings, not model values)
- `Trace.tla`: Added `StringToNat` for string→int node ID conversion, constrained `InsertBegin` height from trace
